name: matched-ks3-all-projection-wd050
hypothesis: Halve weight decay only on dense and routed KS3 projection banks, testing whether original PR393 projection regularization is too strong for the narrower full-KS3 feedforward architecture. Keep all1024/rank1 BF16 GS32 blocks, projection learning rates, geometry Adam0.125/no geometry decay, initialization, original optimizer algorithm, MoE8top1 and every shared/model-wide setting fixed. Retained MLP banks in hybrids keep their original decay. This is a KS3-specific parameter-policy ablation, not a model-wide recipe change.
